concern_1_normalizeResult.demo_tie: Unwraps a single-row []map[string]any postgres result to that row's map, a shape assumption baked from the orders/{id} GET-one-resource read. A flow wanting the array form of a one-row result is surprised.
concern_1_normalizeResult.why_deferred: normalizeResult runs in the connect.Registry wrapper (templatingClient), which sees only connect.Operation — it has NO access to the action node spec. Letting the action node declare 'one row vs many' requires threading a shape declaration from ActionSpec through the frozen connect.Operation seam (or a new out-of-band channel) into the edge wrapper, plus validation and seed changes. Both FMC flows and orders-expedite currently rely on single-row unwrap; changing the default is user-visible. Not 'small given the httpapi rewrite' — the rewrite changed the ROUTER, not this edge adapter.
concern_1_normalizeResult.suggested_follow_up: Add an optional shape declaration to ActionSpec (e.g. result: 'one' | 'many') and plumb it to the edge so normalizeResult is explicit, not guessed. Default must preserve today's single-row-unwrap behavior to avoid breaking existing flows.

concern_2_soleStringValue_branchingEvalu.location: internal/httpapi/adapters.go branchingEvaluator / soleStringValue (wraps decision.Evaluator; consumed by flow conditionHandler.chooseBranch and switchHandler.switchBranch via out["branch"])
concern_2_soleStringValue_branchingEvalu.demo_tie: Promotes a decision output that is a single string value to the 'branch' field regardless of field name — tuned to the order JDM emitting {"shipping":"<branch>"}.
concern_2_soleStringValue_branchingEvalu.why_deferred: The promotion happens in a decision.Evaluator wrapper whose signature is Evaluate(ctx, jdmID, input) — it has NO access to the node spec, so it cannot know which output field the node intends as the branch. Making it config-declared means either changing the frozen decision.Evaluator seam to carry a branch-field, OR moving branch resolution into the frozen flow core (conditionHandler/switchHandler) with a new BranchField on ConditionSpec/SwitchSpec plus validate.go rules. Existing tests pin the current convention (TestBranchingEvaluator, chooseBranch truthy/falsey, interpreter_test.go). Crosses two frozen seams; non-trivial.
concern_2_soleStringValue_branchingEvalu.note: The two NEW FMC flows do NOT exercise this heuristic: they use a decision node (saveAs=dec) + set node reading dec.action explicitly — already config-declared, no guessing. soleStringValue is only reached by the legacy orders-expedite condition path.
concern_2_soleStringValue_branchingEvalu.suggested_follow_up: Add an optional branchField to ConditionSpec/SwitchSpec so the node names which decision output field is the branch, read it in conditionHandler/switchHandler, and retire soleStringValue. Keep the current 'branch'/'result' convention as the fallback default so orders-expedite keeps working.
